reviewMethod: Post-run assistant inspection of every raw transcript against frozen evidence, plus independent second-agent inspection by memory_retrieval. Both reviews were unblinded; this is not a human or blinded external model judge. Findings were reconciled, retaining strict unsupported-addition caveats. Original automatic scores remain unchanged.

criteria.coreAnswerSupported: Answers the requested fact from the supplied evidence, abstains when missing, or gives a creative suggestion when asked.
criteria.materialInventedMemoryFact: Invents a substantive past event, claimed discovery, person detail, or wrong requested answer.
criteria.fullyGroundedUnderLiteralAdditionCriteri: Also avoids even minor unstated additions such as assumed gender or strengthening workplace into current physical presence.
criteria.retrievalProcessNarration: Speaks about executing a lookup or retrieving earlier conversation. Ordinary statements of recall or uncertainty alone do not count.

limitations: One sample per arm per case. No statistical significance claim. These calls used synthetic text with production context delivery, not microphone/gameplay input. The prepared arm still uses memory/records language in abstentions. Both arms assume a gender for Nessa; prepared also strengthens workplace into current presence. The earlier initial-architecture run with an unsupported hearsay embellishment is preserved separately.
